title: The Lover
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'The Lover', Michael reveals to Jim and Pam that he has taken a lover, who is Pam's mother, Helene, leading to tense confrontations and humorous office interactions. The episode explores themes of relationships, personal happiness, and office dynamics, with characters navigating conflicts and humorous banter amid revelations about Michael's romantic life.
